metadata.title: Assigning a parameter to an indexed tensor that was produced by DDP no longer works in torch nightly (1.7)

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



In torch 1.6 assigning a parameter to an indexed tensor successfully create a new tensor which was part of forward graph, this behavior no long works using the latest torch 1.7 nightly

trigger_conditions.condition: Modifying tensors through indexed or view-based in-place operations involving model Parameters during forward execution, followed by backward computation, causing autograd inconsistency.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: In a DDP-wrapped model's forward, assign a Parameter to an advanced-indexed view of an input tensor (e.g., x[[True, False]] = self.token) and then perform backward.

failure_behavior.description: In a DDP-wrapped model's forward, assign a Parameter to an advanced-indexed view of an input tensor (e.g., x[[True, False]] = self.token) and then perform backward.
